LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays Tasks, Events, Email Messages and Chatter posts in a single timeline.

property.name: sortDirection
property.label: Default Sort Direction
property.description: ASC or DESC. Default is DESC (newest first).

property.name: maxItems
property.label: Page Size
property.description: Number of activities loaded per page. Default is 20.

property.name: relatedRecordConfig
property.label: Related Record Fields
property.description: Comma-separated lookup fields to include. Format: FieldApiName:Label. Example: Customer__c:Customer or AccountId:Account,ContactId:Contact. Leave empty for current record only.

property.name: currentRecordLabel
property.label: Current Record Label
property.description: Optional label for activities on the current record. Defaults to the object label.
